app.title: Private Vaults
kit.sidebar.title: Menu
landing.what: Run payroll from vaults your company controls, with every payment approved by the people who sign for it.
landing.privacy: Some payments are private and some are public. Anyone can look up a public payment's amount and who received it, and it is marked Public here.
landing.new.title: New here
landing.new.body: Sign in with your account. Setting up a company here is coming soon.
landing.returning.title: Already set up?
landing.returning.body: Sign in with your account to pick up where you left off.
landing.howSigningInWorks: To sign in, your account opens on this page and signs one message saying it is you. Signing in asks for nothing else and shares no key.
signIn.purpose: So Private Vaults knows it is you. Nothing else is asked for.
signIn.refused.title: You are not signed in
signIn.refused.notSetUp: Signing in is not set up on this site yet, so your account cannot open. Contact whoever runs this site.
signIn.refused.noWindow: Your account did not open, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.windowGone: Your account was closed before it answered, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.declined: You did not approve it in your account, so nothing was signed. Press the button again when you are ready.
signIn.refused.expired: The request had expired by the time it reached your account. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.silent: Your account did not answer, so nothing was signed. It may not have finished opening. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.gaveUp: You stopped waiting, so nothing was signed. Press the button again when you are ready.
signIn.refused.didNotFinish: Signing in did not finish, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.refused: This site could not confirm the signature from your account, so you are not signed in. Press the button again. If it happens again, check you are using the account you signed up with.
signIn.refused.tooMany: There have been too many tries to sign in. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
signIn.refused.tooManyWait_one: There have been too many tries to sign in. Try again in {count} minute.
signIn.refused.tooManyWait_other: There have been too many tries to sign in. Try again in {count} minutes.
signIn.refused.unavailable: Signing in is not available on this site right now. Try again later.
signIn.refused.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached, so nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.
accountFrame.title: Your account
accountFrame.nothingSignedYet: Your account is below. Nothing is signed until you approve it there.
service.unreachable.title: This site's service could not be reached
service.unreachable.body: Nothing has changed. Check your connection, then try again.
service.recordsApart.title: Your companies cannot be shown right now
service.recordsApart.body: Some of your companies were set up for real and some in this site's test setup, so they are not shown together. Sign out and tell whoever runs this site. They can separate the two.
noPage.title: There is nothing to open here
noPage.body: No page you can open is at this address. It may have moved, or it may be for another view.
page.landing.name: Welcome
page.join.name: Join a company
page.join.soon: Where a person arriving from an invitation link joins the company that invited them, to be paid or to sign.
page.setup.name: Set up your company
page.setup.soon: A guided setup, one step to a page. Create the company, add signers and set approvals, create a vault and deposit. Then add people, run payroll and choose who can change the company's rules.
page.home.name: Home
page.home.soon: The first screen after you sign in: proposals waiting for you, your vaults, the next payroll run and people waiting to join.
page.proposals.name: Proposals
page.proposals.soon: Every proposal the signers raise and approve, with the number waiting for you beside it in the menu.
page.payroll.name: Payroll
page.payroll.soon: Paying people: every payroll run, a run's own page, and starting a new run.
page.vaults.name: Vaults
page.vaults.soon: Where the company's money is held: each vault's private and public money, its deposits and its payouts.
page.transactions.name: Transactions
page.transactions.soon: Every payment in and out, filterable.
page.reports.name: Reports
page.people.name: People
page.people.soon: Everyone the company pays, and each person's own page.
page.invitations.name: Invitations
page.invitations.soon: Bringing people in: links you sent, codes you received, and people waiting for the fingerprint check.
page.disclosures.name: Disclosures
page.disclosures.soon: Proof of a payroll total that you share with an accountant, a bank or a tax office, without listing what each person is paid.
page.policies.name: Policies
page.policies.soon: Rules for the company's money, such as a spending limit for each vault.
page.activity.name: Activity log
page.apps.name: Apps
page.apps.soon: Add-ons installed on the company, and what each one can see.
page.settings.name: Settings
page.settingsCompany.name: Company
page.settingsCompany.soon: The company's name and logo, and the language new employees see first.
page.settingsSigners.name: Signers and approvals
page.settingsSigners.soon: Who signs for the company, how many must approve, and who can change the company's rules.
page.settingsRoles.name: Roles and permissions
page.settingsRoles.soon: What each person in the company can see and do.
page.settingsAppearance.name: Appearance
page.settingsLanguage.name: Language
page.settingsAccount.name: Account and devices
page.settingsAccount.soon: The account you are signed in with, and the devices signed in to it.
page.settingsNotifications.name: Notifications
page.settingsNotifications.soon: Which updates reach you, and how.
page.settingsBilling.name: Billing
page.payHome.name: Home
page.payHome.soon: Your latest payslip, your next pay date and the company that pays you.
page.payslips.name: Payslips
page.payslips.soon: One payslip a month, each saying whether it has been paid and whether privately or publicly.
page.paymentsReceived.name: Payments received
page.paymentsReceived.soon: The pay each company has recorded paying you.
page.myDetails.name: My details
page.myDetails.soon: Your name, where you are paid, and your tax details.
page.documents.name: Documents
page.documents.soon: Documents your company shares with you.

language.numberFormat.soon: Show dates and numbers in a different format from your language, for example 1.234,50 on an English page.

view.banner: You are looking at your own pay.
